answer: A newcomer earns weight only after its answers survive a graded voyage across 10 successive epochs, each passed answer adding one link to a public chain any peer can re-check. A relic answer from 5 epochs back is pulled at random for re-grading, and if the re-grade contradicts the original, the whole chain drops to zero weight. Each link is stamped in umber ink once it passes, so a fake must produce 10 consistent graded answers in a row; 100 fakes need 1,000 clean answers, and one contradiction wipes a chain.
